proof_scope: FastAPI control-plane standards, Memory persistence boundaries, deployment handoff boundaries, and Flask fallback adapter generation

claims.proves: the skill has an executable converter, validates route manifests with Pydantic, generates a Flask adapter over shared contracts/service, rejects invalid manifests, documents Memory as default persistence, and documents Terraform as an external skill handoff
claims.does_not_prove: a deployed cloud service, production auth, real OpenAI/Astra access, live cyber scanning, or live Memory writes

cases.name: skill-documents-memory-default-boundary
command: grep -Fq 'default persistence boundary' ../SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'Qdrant directly' ../SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'Do not add a second database' ../SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'Memory-native method' ../SKILL.md

cases.name: skill-documents-terraform-external-boundary
command: grep -q "Terraform stays outside the app" ../SKILL.md && grep -q "Never reimplement" ../SKILL.md

cases.name: openai-control-plane-contract-shape
command: grep -Fq 'Cyber-safety eval control-plane slice' ../SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'Memory stack' ../SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'Terraform stays outside the app' ../SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'FastAPI/React code is the demo surface' /home/graham/workspace/experiments/openai-interview/README.md

cases.name: skill-documents-swagger-openapi-demo-harness
command: grep -Fq 'Swagger/OpenAPI as a demo harness' ../SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'Body(..., openapi_examples' ../SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'tryItOutEnabled' ../SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'API-key security scheme' ../SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'data-qid' ../SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'externalDocs' ../SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'x-code-location' ../SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'Uvicorn reload restarts the server' ../SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'OpenAI Actions' ../SKILL.md

capability_claims.description: The skill encodes the FastAPI/Pydantic/Memory boundaries needed to quickly shape Graham’s OpenAI interview control-plane artifact.
The skill can generate a Flask fallback adapter over shared Pydantic contracts/service logic without moving business logic into Flask.
The skill encodes how to turn standard FastAPI Swagger/OpenAPI into a purposeful interview/demo harness without custom frontend work.
